info.title: navius - copy-paste component registry for Blazor (Navius
info.description: Copy-paste component registry CLI for Blazor and zits/ui.

options.name: --styled-only
options.description:
copy only the styled zits/ui + lib files; consume the Navius
headless brain as the Navius.Primitives NuGet package instead
of vendoring it. Cannot be combined with --namespace.

options.name: --overwrite
options.description: replace target files that already exist (default: skip them).
